acceptanceRule: After cycle-9 changes, re-running the identical probe with the identical LEGACY STRING move script MUST reproduce all three sha256 values exactly and MUST yield exactly these 26 commander keys. Presence of 'moveAnalog', 'aimX', 'aimY', or any corpse/extraction field in an octant-only run is a FAILURE of the conditional-presence contract (spec defect D4), not an acceptable diff.
whyThisMatters: getRunSnapshot() line 3510 serialises the ENTIRE commander object, so any unconditionally-added field enters the digest and breaks PR #10's depth-0 byte-identity contract plus every stored replay fixture.
notes: [OBSERVED] These three hashes were produced by an actual run of the probe against commit 033877ad before any agent edited a source file.
This artifact is evidence of a pre-state, not a gate verdict. It proves nothing about whether the loop is fun (G7) or immersive (G4).
